newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila forex mart closed, few deals in grey market.
newsitem.headline: Manila forex mart closed, few deals in grey market.

text.p: * Volumes said very thin in grey market
The Philippine Dealing System (PDS), the computerised peso-dollar trading system, was closed on Friday in view of the ongoing meetings of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC).
But some banks were trading in the parallel market, traders said.
Volume was thin and trades were way off the previous deals at the PDS, they said.
One trader said the peso had traded at 26.36 pesos to the dollar in the grey market.
The peso closed at 26.278 to the dollar on Thursday.
